name: Driftbone
lore: Everything the sea gave back, standing in the order it washed up. It does not go near the water.
prompt: Hunched body built of sea-smoothed driftwood limbs bleached grey-white and wedged together, knotted rope lashing the joints, crusts of barnacles and dried weed along its back, sand running steadily out of the gaps between the timbers
